visual.title: Six symmetries of a triangle
visual.caption: S3 is the symmetry group of a triangle. Its table is the composition of the six permutations, and it is not abelian.

predict.question: How many elements does the symmetry group of a triangle have?
predict.explain: Three rotations and three reflections give six symmetries, matching the six permutations in S3.
